verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions is documented as built-in CI/CD with YAML workflows that are syntax-compatible with GitHub Actions, and there is an official action runner, so pipelines-as-code is first-party. However, no evidence explicitly documents automatic triggering on pushes and pull requests or shows hands-on runs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of push/pull-request triggers, detail on where workflow files live in the repository, independent or hands-on corroboration of Gitea Actions running pipelines.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define CI/CD pipelines as code in my repository and have them run automatically on pushes and pull requests

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
an action runner for Gitea Action
